Impact Capital VC / Portfolio

Agentic marketing intelligence

Defy

AI insight and automation for agencies and brand teams

Defy combines Defy Monitor for competitor, audience and conversation data, Defy MCP for querying that data inside AI assistants, and Defy Agents for automating repetitive delivery work.

Investment note · August 25, 2026

Why we invested in Defy

Independent agencies and in-house brand teams compete against holding networks that spend heavily on proprietary data and AI. Defy gives smaller teams comparable analytical and automation capabilities without the build cost or the maintenance burden, and every insight traces back to the published content behind it.

We backed co-founders Ian Cassidy, Defy's CEO and a former creative agency leader, and Professor Aleks Farseev, its CTO and an AI scientist based in Singapore. The pairing of agency-side commercial instinct with research-grade AI is exactly the founder profile our fund was built to support.

Early adoption by a global consumer-appliance strategy team and a UK CRM agency confirms our view that agentic workflows will become standard infrastructure for agencies.
